annotations.title: Create an upload URL for a contact file

description: Get a URL for a CSV or Excel file up to 10 MB. You need a shell that can reach our API: PUT the raw file bytes to the URL with no API key header, outside MCP. The URL works for 10 minutes. Keep it secret. The PUT returns the same import preview as create_contact_import; review it, use update_contact_import if needed, then commit_contact_import with its revision. A retry with a still-valid used URL returns the same import without reading the file again. Current key and maker authority is checked before reading bytes and again before writing, including retries. An Idempotency-Key replay of this mint has url null: if the first answer was lost, call again with a new Idempotency-Key. Without a shell, use upsert_contacts in batches of 500, or ask a person to upload the file in the console.

fileName.description: The file's name, like leads.csv. It's shown back to you, and the import's label is named after it.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
